Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

stanSPsurv 0.1.0

CRAN submission

  • First public release. R CMD check --as-cran passes with Status: OK.
  • License changed from CC0 to MIT.

Validation

  • Added 100-replication parameter recovery study for all six specifications (3 structures × 2 baselines, N = 500). Zero divergences across 600 runs, Rhat < 1.001, 81–97 % empirical coverage of 90 % credible intervals.
  • Added 50-replication head-to-head comparison with BayesSPsurv: comparable bias, 40–1 000× higher ESS per second in stanSPsurv.
  • Documented a case-sensitivity bug in BayesSPsurv’s MCMC engine that prevents the Weibull shape parameter from being sampled.

Plotting

  • Added plot.stanSPsurv() for coefficient forest plots.
  • Added plot_survival() for survival curves with credible bands.
  • Added plot_susceptibility() for susceptibility probability curves.
  • Added plot_frailty() for frailty caterpillar plots.
  • Added plot_choropleth() for spatial frailty maps with maps and sf back-ends.

Data and documentation

  • Added conflict_spells simulated dataset for examples and testing.
  • Added introductory vignette covering all model families and plotting.
  • Full roxygen documentation for all 13 exported functions and methods.
  • Added CITATION file.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed complete.cases() failure when split formula is intercept-only.

stanSPsurv 0.0.3.9000

  • Split the pooled, exchangeable, and spatial implementations into separate Stan programs so inactive frailty parameters are never sampled.
  • Corrected counting-process likelihoods to mix susceptible and immune populations once per episode through the new spell argument.
  • Reparameterized positive scales on the log scale and added regularizing priors for weakly identified split-population models.
  • Replaced the unscaled dual ICAR with a scaled proper-CAR mixture that handles disconnected components and isolated areas.
  • Re-ran the Walter (2015) benchmark: pooled, exchangeable, and spatial models completed with zero divergences and zero maximum-treedepth transitions.

stanSPsurv 0.0.2.9000

  • Added a reproducible V-Dem 16 / ERT 16 application for democratic-breakdown spells.
  • Created the initial R package structure with pooled, exchangeable, and spatial split-population survival models.
  • Added Weibull and log-logistic baselines, coefficient/prediction/frailty helpers, counting-process support, and input-validation tests.
